Sheet Pan Gnocchi with Peppers

Story about busy weeknights.

Sheet Pan Gnocchi

Servings: 4 people
Prep Time 10 minutes
Cook Time 25 minutes

Ingredients

Gnocchi

  • 1 lb shelf-stable gnocchi
  • 2 tbsp olive oil

Vegetables

  • 2 bell peppers, sliced
  • 1 red onion, cut in wedges

Instructions

  • Heat the oven to 425°F.
  • Toss everything with oil on a sheet pan.
  • Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once.

Notes

Fresh gnocchi needs only 15 minutes.

Other gnocchi

  • 1 cup peas
